comparison.interpretation: Current-RTL feature ablation of Conv cache, segment lookahead and B-prefetch/acquire; native 64-bit reads shared; accuracy not measured

configuration.write_byte_accounting: sum popcount(WSTRB) over accepted AXI32 write beats

diagnostic_counter_definitions.aggregation: Counters summed across relevant commands; a_max, b_max and max are maximum of layer maxima
diagnostic_counter_definitions.core: Observed core_busy cycles inside Conv/FC EX_RUN; not PE-valid MAC events
diagnostic_counter_definitions.dense_nominal_mac: Logical M*N*K, including Conv boundary padding
diagnostic_counter_definitions.executed_mac_events: Not exposed by this common testbench; no actual MAC count inferred
diagnostic_counter_definitions.operand: Observed read_path_busy cycles inside Conv/FC EX_RUN
diagnostic_counter_definitions.partition: core=overlap+compute_only; operand=overlap+operand_only; run=overlap+compute_only+operand_only+neither; validated for all 54 Conv/FC commands in each variant
diagnostic_counter_definitions.throughput_denominator: Whole-network PERF_TOTAL cycles including all 72 commands and control/memory wait
diagnostic_counter_definitions.useful_mac: Valid-input-coordinate geometric MACs; excludes Conv padding and physical tile tails; no input/weight-zero gating
